headline: What The FPL — Team Of The Week — GW7
body: The What The FPL Team of the Week for Gameweek 6! What is What The FPL? What The FPL is a website I'm running to predict and evaluate predictions around FPL. I've been posting my results and others' since last season. My model is based on historical data, odds and ML predictions. Over the past season it outperformed the likes of Fantasy Football Scout and the FPL team of the week picks. Since this season I'm tracking the accuracy of all free points predictor models to see which is best at whatthef.pl/evaluation . So far this season, What The FPL has been the best in it's category. Last week An decent week, scoring 63 points which was 6 points above the GW average, and one of the highest GW scores of model based predictions as per fplbench.com .The main differentials being Dewsbury-Hall and Mbeumo, both scoring big. This week (Free Hit) De Cuyper missed out last minute. Double Fulham against Hull, double Spurs against Coventry, and double City against Ipswich. Haaland a good TC option though might be suspect to some rotation (early sub). Overall a very balanced team in my opinion, though I'm not 100% sure about the defence. Wildcard The new Wildcard mode shows the optimal selection for 100m for the upcoming 5GWs, assuming you make no transfers. The team has ofcourse big overlap with last week, though some of the cheaper assets get rotated to target specific fixtures. For example, Savio makes the team with 3 good fixtures in the next 5, where the model aims to bench him for the other 2 games rotating with Wirtz.   submitted by   /u/WhatTheFPL [link]   [comments]
